about: Held-out planner window check, written before the third revision's prompt change and before any run of it. today = 2026-11-25 (a Wednesday). Each item gives the expected operation, window and, for comparisons, compare_window. Not used to write the prompt.

items.q: Did I take more steps in the past 7 days than in the 7 days before that?
Compare my average steps over the 7 days ending yesterday with the week before that.
Was my sleep in the last 14 days longer or shorter than in the 14 days before?
Not counting today, how did my resting heart rate over the last 7 days compare with the 7 days before that?
Am I walking more this week than last week?
How does my HRV over the past 30 days compare to the 30 days before that?
Did I sleep more over the 3 nights ending yesterday than over the 3 nights before those?
Steps: last 7 days excluding today versus the previous 7 days. Higher, lower or the same?
What was my average daily step count over the last 7 days?
What was my total step count for the 7 days ending yesterday?
How many nights in the last 7 nights did I sleep under 6 hours?
How many days in the 14 days ending yesterday did I walk more than 10,000 steps?
What was my resting heart rate yesterday?
Is my HRV trending up or down over the last 28 days?
What was my average sleep duration over the last 14 days, not counting today?
Did I sleep less than usual over the last 3 nights ending yesterday?
